messages:
maya: Quick sync: product wants the canary cost card to show per-token spend AND cache-saved tokens. Right now total delta hides cases where KV cache saved most of the cost.

sid: Agreed. Plan: emit a compact snapshot at rollout snapshot time (one aggregate row per route+variant). Payload minimal: route, variant, invocations, tokens_charged, cache_saved_tokens, token_cost_cents, baseline_snapshot_id, reasons[], approx. Keep it small so we don't blow up ingest.

al: UX notes: render a split bar: red=token spend, green=cache savings (as negative). Hover shows cents + token counts. Add a per-1k-invokes normalized delta for comparison. Toggle per-invocation vs per-token averages.

maya: Product also asked for a short "why" pill: top_reason enum (model_swap|token_shift|prompt_change) + confidence percent. Heuristics must be explainable not magic.

sid: Heuristic sketch: if variant_id differs -> model_swap. If median tokens shift >20% -> token_shift. If prompt overlap <60% -> prompt_change. Confidence = f(sample_size, magnitude). Mark snapshot approx=true if sample < 200.

prod-bot: snapshot recorded rollout=canary-2026-03-24T12:40Z by @maya

maya: Action items: sid will post POST /internal/v1/snapshots contract + sample payloads (ETA Tue). al will mock UI with stacked bar + toggle (ETA Wed). I'll update rollout runbook and check audit retention (90d default).

sid: ack. I'll sign the blob server-side and store immutable snapshot metadata.

al: CSV export requested by PMs; will add export button.

maya: Thanks all. Keeping this thread for decisions.
